test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

I haven’t found a job yet but I am going to __keep trying__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'No substitution required'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence has **no grammatical error.**
 
• There is no error in **'keep trying'** part of the sentence.
 
• ** Keep trying** is an** idiom** that means to continue putting forth effort to succeed at some task, activity, endeavor.
 
 
• ***Example:** Don't give up, keep trying , you are on the right path.*
 
 
 
• From the given meaning of the idiom and its example sentence, we are sure that it's usage in the above sentence brings the same sense as its** meaning.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
